name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  gofmt:
    name: Go Format Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: Check Go formatting
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(gofmt -s -l .)" ]; then
            echo "Go code is not formatted. Please run 'gofmt -s -w .'"
            gofmt -s -d .
            exit 1
          fi

  golangci-lint:
    name: Go Linting
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --timeout=5m

  go-fix:
    name: Go Fix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: Check for suspicious constructs or opportunities for improvement
        run: go fix -diff ./...

  go-mod-tidy:
    name: Go Modules Tidy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: Check if go.mod/go.sum are tidy
        run: go mod tidy -diff

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: Test
        run: go test -v -short ./...

  release-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - uses: anchore/sbom-action/download-syft@v0
      - name: Install GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v7
        with:
          install-only: true
      - name: Check release (dry-run)
        run: |
          goreleaser release --snapshot --clean --skip publish
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GORELEASER_GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN }}

  integration-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: rootsdev/trellis-cli-dev
    steps:
      - run: go version
      - run: ansible --version
      - name: Trellis version
        run: git log -1 --format="%h %s %aD"
        working-directory: /test/dummy/trellis
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: |
            ~/go/pkg/mod
            ~/.cache/go-build
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: Tests
        run: make test RUN=
      - name: Store artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: trellis-cli
          path: /test/trellis-cli

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
